descFull: Highly customizable Angular loading spinner library with 50+ animations, multiple named spinners, an optional HTTP interceptor for automatic show/hide, MatDialog-safe fullscreen overlays via the Popover API, and one-command ng add setup. Supports Angular 4–22, standalone & NgModule apps.
